verses.original: Σὺ οὖν τέκνον μου ἐνδυναμοῦ ἐν τῇ χάριτι τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Sy oun teknon mou endynamou en tē chariti tē en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: You therefore my child be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, filho meu, fortifica-te na graça que é em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: καὶ ἃ ἤκουσας παρ’ ἐμοῦ διὰ πολλῶν μαρτύρων ταῦτα παράθου πιστοῖς ἀνθρώποις οἵτινες ἱκανοὶ ἔσονται καὶ ἑτέρους διδάξαι
verses.transliteration: kai ha ēkousas par’ emou dia pollōn martyrōn tauta parathou pistois anthrōpois hoitines hikanoi esontai kai heterous didaxai
verses.literal: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well
verses.literalPt: E o que de mim ouviste diante de muitas testemunhas, entrega-o a homens fiéis, os quais sejam capazes de ensinar também a outros.

verses.original: Συνκακοπάθησον ὡς καλὸς στρατιώτης Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Synkakopathēson hōs kalos stratiōtēs Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: Join me in suffering like a good soldier of Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Sofre comigo como bom soldado de Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς στρατευόμενος ἐμπλέκεται ταῖς τοῦ βίου πραγματείαις ἵνα τῷ στρατολογήσαντι ἀρέσῃ
verses.transliteration: oudeis strateuomenos empleketai tais tou biou pragmateiais hina tō stratologēsanti aresē
verses.literal: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs in order to please the one who enlisted him
verses.literalPt: Nenhum soldado em serviço se embaraça com os negócios desta vida, para que possa agradar àquele que o alistou.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ ἀθλῇ τις οὐ στεφανοῦται ἐὰν μὴ νομίμως ἀθλήσῃ
verses.transliteration: ean de kai athlē tis ou stephanoutai ean mē nomimōs athlēsē
verses.literal: Likewise . . . a competitor does not receive the crown unless . . . he competes according to the rules
verses.literalPt: Se alguém combater nos jogos públicos, não é coroado sem que tenha combatido segundo as regras.

verses.original: τὸν κοπιῶντα γεωργὸν δεῖ πρῶτον τῶν καρπῶν μεταλαμβάνειν
verses.transliteration: ton kopiōnta geōrgon dei prōton tōn karpōn metalambanein
verses.literal: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops
verses.literalPt: O lavrador que trabalha deve ser o primeiro a gozar dos frutos.

verses.original: νόει ὃ λέγω δώσει γάρ σοι ὁ Κύριος σύνεσιν ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: noei ho legō dōsei gar soi ho Kyrios synesin en pasin
verses.literal: Consider what I am saying for the Lord will give you insight into all things
verses.literalPt: Pensa bem no que digo, porque o Senhor te dará compreensão em tudo.

verses.original: Μνημόνευε Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐγηγερμένον ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐκ σπέρματος Δαυίδ κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιόν μου
verses.transliteration: Mnēmoneue Iēsoun Christon egēgermenon ek nekrōn ek spermatos Dauid kata to euangelion mou
verses.literal: Remember Jesus Christ raised from the dead descended from David as proclaimed by my gospel
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te de Jesus Cristo, ressuscitado dentre os mortos, descendente de Davi, segundo o meu evangelho;

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ κακοπαθῶ μέχρι δεσμῶν ὡς κακοῦργος ἀλλὰ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐ δέδεται
verses.transliteration: en hō kakopathō mechri desmōn hōs kakourgos alla ho logos tou Theou ou dedetai
verses.literal: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal But the word of God cannot be chained
verses.literalPt: no qual sofro, a ponto de ser preso como malfeitor; mas a palavra de Deus não está presa.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο πάντα ὑπομένω διὰ τοὺς ἐκλεκτούς ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ σωτηρίας τύχωσιν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μετὰ δόξης αἰωνίου
verses.transliteration: dia touto panta hypomenō dia tous eklektous hina kai autoi sōtērias tychōsin tēs en Christō Iēsou meta doxēs aiōniou
verses.literal: For this reason . . . I endure all things for the sake of the elect so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory
verses.literalPt: Portanto, sofro tudo por amor dos escolhidos, para que eles também alcancem a salvação que é em Cristo Jesus, com a glória eterna.

verses.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος Εἰ γὰρ συναπεθάνομεν καὶ συζήσομεν
verses.transliteration: Pistos ho logos Ei gar synapethanomen kai syzēsomen
verses.literal: This is a trustworthy saying If we died with Him we will also live with Him
verses.literalPt: Fiel é esta palavra: se, pois, já morremos com ele, com ele também viveremos; se perseveramos, reinaremos também com ele;

verses.original: εἰ ὑπομένομεν καὶ συμβασιλεύσομεν εἰ ἀρνησόμεθα κἀκεῖνος ἀρνήσεται ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: ei hypomenomen kai symbasileusomen ei arnēsometha kakeinos arnēsetai hēmas
verses.literal: if we endure we will also reign with Him if we deny Him He will also deny us
verses.literalPt: se o negarmos, ele também nos negará a nós;

verses.original: εἰ ἀπιστοῦμεν ἐκεῖνος πιστὸς μένει ἀρνήσασθαι γὰρ ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται
verses.transliteration: ei apistoumen ekeinos pistos menei arnēsasthai gar heauton ou dynatai
verses.literal: if we are faithless He remains faithful for He cannot deny Himself
verses.literalPt: se somos infiéis, ele permanece fiel, porque não pode negar-se a si mesmo.

verses.original: Ταῦτα ὑπομίμνῃσκε διαμαρτυρόμενος ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ μὴ λογομαχεῖν ἐπ’ οὐδὲν χρήσιμον ἐπὶ καταστροφῇ τῶν ἀκουόντων
verses.transliteration: Tauta hypomimnēske diamartyromenos enōpion tou Theou mē logomachein ep’ ouden chrēsimon epi katastrophē tōn akouontōn
verses.literal: Remind the believers of these things charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin
verses.literalPt: Lembra-lhes essas coisas, conjurando-os diante de Deus, que não tenham contendas de palavras que para nada aproveitam, senão para perverter os que as ouvem.

verses.original: Σπούδασον σεαυτὸν δόκιμον παραστῆσαι τῷ Θεῷ ἐργάτην ἀνεπαίσχυντον ὀρθοτομοῦντα τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: Spoudason seauton dokimon parastēsai tō Theō ergatēn anepaischynton orthotomounta ton logon tēs alētheias
verses.literal: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth
verses.literalPt: Esforça-te para te apresentar diante de Deus aprovado, como obreiro que não tem de que se envergonhar e que maneja bem a palavra da verdade.

verses.original: Τὰς δὲ βεβήλους κενοφωνίας περιΐστασο ἐπὶ πλεῖον γὰρ προκόψουσιν ἀσεβείας
verses.transliteration: Tas de bebēlous kenophōnias periistaso epi pleion gar prokopsousin asebeias
verses.literal: But avoid irreverent empty chatter which will only lead to more ungodliness
verses.literalPt: Mas evita as conversas vãs e profanas; porque os que delas usam passarão à impiedade ainda maior,

verses.original: καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτῶν ὡς γάγγραινα νομὴν ἕξει ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Φιλητός
verses.transliteration: kai ho logos autōn hōs gangraina nomēn hexei hōn estin Hymenaios kai Philētos
verses.literal: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus
verses.literalPt: e as suas palavras lavrarão como gangrena. Deste número são Himeneu e Fileto,

verses.original: οἵτινες περὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἠστόχησαν λέγοντες τὴν ἀνάστασιν ἤδη γεγονέναι καὶ ἀνατρέπουσιν τήν τινων πίστιν
verses.transliteration: hoitines peri tēn alētheian ēstochēsan legontes tēn anastasin ēdē gegonenai kai anatrepousin tēn tinōn pistin
verses.literal: who have deviated from the truth They say that the resurrection has already occurred and they undermine the faith of some
verses.literalPt: os quais se desviaram da verdade, dizendo que a ressurreição é já passada, e assim pervertem a fé de alguns.

verses.original: Ὁ μέντοι στερεὸς θεμέλιος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἕστηκεν ἔχων τὴν σφραγῖδα ταύτην Ἔγνω Κύριος τοὺς ὄντας αὐτοῦ καί Ἀποστήτω ἀπὸ ἀδικίας πᾶς ὁ ὀνομάζων τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Ho mentoi stereos themelios tou Theou hestēken echōn tēn sphragida tautēn Egnō Kyrios tous ontas autou kai Apostētō apo adikias pas ho onomazōn to onoma Kyriou
verses.literal: Nevertheless God’s firm foundation stands bearing this seal The Lord knows those who are His and Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, o firme fundamento de Deus permanece, tendo este selo: O Senhor conhece os que são dele, e: Aparte-se da injustiça todo aquele que pronuncia o nome do Senhor.

verses.original: Ἐν μεγάλῃ δὲ οἰκίᾳ οὐκ ἔστιν μόνον σκεύη χρυσᾶ καὶ ἀργυρᾶ ἀλλὰ καὶ ξύλινα καὶ ὀστράκινα καὶ ἃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν ἃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν
verses.transliteration: En megalē de oikia ouk estin monon skeuē chrysa kai argyra alla kai xylina kai ostrakina kai ha men eis timēn ha de eis atimian
verses.literal: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver but also of wood and clay Some indeed are for honorable use but others are for common use
verses.literalPt: Ora, numa grande casa há não somente vasos de ouro e de prata, mas os há também de madeira e de barro; uns, na verdade, são para uso de honra, outros, porém, para uso vil.

verses.original: ἐὰν οὖν τις ἐκκαθάρῃ ἑαυτὸν ἀπὸ τούτων ἔσται σκεῦος εἰς τιμήν ἡγιασμένον εὔχρηστον τῷ δεσπότῃ εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἡτοιμασμένον
verses.transliteration: ean oun tis ekkatharē heauton apo toutōn estai skeuos eis timēn hēgiasmenon euchrēston tō despotē eis pan ergon agathon hētoimasmenon
verses.literal: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit he will be a vessel for honor sanctified useful to the Master and prepared for every good work
verses.literalPt: Se, pois, alguém se purificar deste, ele será um vaso de honra, santificado, útil ao Senhor e preparado para toda boa obra.

verses.original: Τὰς δὲ νεωτερικὰς ἐπιθυμίας φεῦγε δίωκε δὲ δικαιοσύνην πίστιν ἀγάπην εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν ἐπικαλουμένων τὸν Κύριον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας
verses.transliteration: Tas de neōterikas epithymias pheuge diōke de dikaiosynēn pistin agapēn eirēnēn meta tōn epikaloumenōn ton Kyrion ek katharas kardias
verses.literal: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness faith love and peace together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart
verses.literalPt: Foge também das paixões da mocidade e segue a justiça, a fé, o amor, a paz com aqueles que invocam o Senhor com um coração puro.

verses.original: Τὰς δὲ μωρὰς καὶ ἀπαιδεύτους ζητήσεις παραιτοῦ εἰδὼς ὅτι γεννῶσιν μάχας
verses.transliteration: Tas de mōras kai apaideutous zētēseis paraitou eidōs hoti gennōsin machas
verses.literal: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation for you know that it breeds quarreling
verses.literalPt: Rejeita as questões absurdas e desassisadas, sabendo que elas provocam brigas.

verses.original: δοῦλον δὲ Κυρίου οὐ δεῖ μάχεσθαι ἀλλὰ ἤπιον εἶναι πρὸς πάντας διδακτικόν ἀνεξίκακον
verses.transliteration: doulon de Kyriou ou dei machesthai alla ēpion einai pros pantas didaktikon anexikakon
verses.literal: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone able to teach and forbearing
verses.literalPt: Ora, o servo do Senhor não deve brigar, mas deve ser condescendente para com todos, capaz de ensinar, sofrido,

verses.original: ἐν πραΰτητι παιδεύοντα τοὺς ἀντιδιατιθεμένους μή‿ ποτε δώῃ αὐτοῖς ὁ Θεὸς μετάνοιαν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: en prautēti paideuonta tous antidiatithemenous mē pote dōē autois ho Theos metanoian eis epignōsin alētheias
verses.literal: He must gently reprove those who oppose him in the hope that . . . God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth
verses.literalPt: que corrija com mansidão aos que se opõem, na esperança de que Deus lhes conceda o arrependimento para conhecerem a verdade,

verses.original: καὶ ἀνανήψωσιν ἐκ τῆς τοῦ διαβόλου παγίδος ἐζωγρημένοι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἐκείνου θέλημα
verses.transliteration: kai ananēpsōsin ek tēs tou diabolou pagidos ezōgrēmenoi hyp’ autou eis to ekeinou thelēma
verses.literal: Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil who has taken them captive . . . to his will
verses.literalPt: e que despertem e se livrem do laço do Diabo (tendo sido feitos cativos por ele), para cumprirem a vontade de Deus.
